run_SMPLify_call: run SMPLify body fitting to optimize 3D mesh pose and shape from 2D keypoints
run_SMPLify_run_withWeakProj: run SMPLify body fitting with weak perspective camera projection and optional debug visualization
build_SMPLify_init: build an SMPLify optimizer instance with configurable step size, batch size, and iteration count
test_SMPLify_get_fitting_loss: test the SMPLify module by computing reprojection loss for given pose and camera parameters
test_SMPLify_get_prior_loss: test the SMPLify module by computing GMM pose prior loss for given pose and beta parameters
